name: OpenHermes 2.5
description: A compilation and curation of approximately one million primarily synthetic instruction-following and chat samples, assembled from open-source and custom-generated datasets to train generalist language-model assistants.
citation: Teknium. (2023). OpenHermes 2.5: An Open Dataset of Synthetic Data for Generalist LLM Assistants. https://huggingface.co/datasets/teknium/OpenHermes-2.5
